patterns.note: Full-width content sections with a consistent maximum width for text and interactive elements, often using a grid for sub-sections like challenges and showcases.
Extremely large, custom-designed, rounded, and heavy display fonts are used for all major section headings, creating a playful and distinctive visual identity.
A vibrant and playful primary color palette (pinks, oranges, purples, light blues) is used for headings, illustrations, and call-to-action elements, set against a clean white background.
The header transforms upon scroll: the initial large hero header with the main title and date disappears, and a smaller, sticky navigation bar with only the logo and links appears at the top.
Each major content section is introduced with a prominent, custom-font heading and often features large, whimsical, hand-drawn illustrations that visually break up the page and reinforce the theme.

technique_notes: The site implements a transforming sticky header that dynamically reduces its height and content (removing the main title and date) as the user scrolls down, providing a more compact and persistent navigation bar.

Content sections are visually segmented by large, custom-font headings and integrated hand-drawn illustrations that often extend beyond the main content column, creating a playful and engaging visual flow.

A subtle, fixed background pattern resembling ruled notebook paper is used, giving the impression that the page content scrolls over a static, themed canvas, reinforcing the educational and creative context.

design_tokens.type_scale: Oversized, heavy, rounded display headings (~4-5x body text) with a playful character, contrasted with a clear, legible sans-serif for body copy.
design_tokens.radius: Subtle (buttons, input fields, and card corners have a slight, consistent curve).
design_tokens.spacing: Balanced to airy, with generous vertical spacing between major sections and within the hero, and a more standard density for card grids and lists.

standout: The site's distinctive blend of a highly technical subject (coding) with an overtly playful, hand-drawn, and almost childlike aesthetic, characterized by custom, bubbly typography and whimsical illustrations. This creates an inviting and non-intimidating learning environment.
